rules: EAGLE FORM: the girl's eagle is a photoreal golden-brown eagle that MUST retain her identity thread (same amber eye warmth, soft gaze); never a generic or cartoon bird; off-model eagle = REJECT

WIZARD KITE: aged, white-bearded sorcerer with a carved wooden staff; no modern props, no firearm or gun silhouette anywhere
